concerns.text: The specification’s non‑functional requirement SC‑005 mandates a per‑cell‑line runtime limit of 2 hours, but no task explicitly verifies or enforces this per‑cell‑line bound; T009 only checks total pipeline wall‑time ≤ 6 h.

SC‑004 requires the performance‑gap analysis to be reproducible, yet the permutation‑based enrichment test in T007 (and any stochastic steps for the gap calculation) do not mention a fixed random seed or deterministic logging, leaving reproducibility unguaranteed.
